summary: Full-stack testing of LifeOS. Backend: 34 pytest cases across auth, tasks, bills, expenses, documents (mock OCR), appointments, habits, shopping, dashboard aggregate, global search, data isolation and AI (SSE chat + plan-day) — 33 passed, 1 failed (no brute-force lockout on login). Frontend: full E2E on desktop (1920) and mobile (390) — login, dashboard KPIs/cards, Quick-Add (task + expense), Tasks CRUD + filters, Money bills/expenses + mark-paid + delete, Calendar grid nav + add appointment, More (Documents/Habits/Shopping), global search, Assistant live streaming, Plan-my-day AI card, mobile bottom nav, session persistence after reload, logout. All core flows work; no 5xx errors, no blocked buttons, no console errors after auth.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection / rate limiting. 6 consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401 (no 423/429 lockout). Playbook requires lockout after 5 failed attempts.

allow_origin_regex=r'https?://.*' combined with allow_credentials=True reflects ANY origin while auth cookie is SameSite=None;Secure — effectively allows cross-site credentialed requests (CSRF/data-exfil risk). Should rely on explicit FRONTEND_URL origins only.
Update handler strips all None values, so a field can never be cleared (e.g. removing a due_date or notes is impossible). Use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) instead.
No PATCH/PUT endpoint — expenses can only be created and deleted (frontend has no edit either).

design_issues.screen: Tasks / Money (add bill) / Calendar (add appointment) / More (document expiry)
issues: All date pickers use the browser-default native input (renders as 'mm/dd/yyyy' and 'mm/dd/yyyy, --:-- --') instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component — inconsistent with the dark-first design language and unstyled on desktop Chrome. Files: Tasks.jsx:78, Money.jsx:135, More.jsx:34, Calendar.jsx:149

The datetime-local field is not pre-filled from the day cell the user just selected, so an appointment added while 'Aug 15' is selected can silently land in a different month and appear to have not been created (toast says 'Appointment added' but nothing shows in the grid).
KPI labels 'BILLS NEXT 30D' and 'SPENT THIS MONTH' wrap to two lines, giving the 2x2 KPI grid uneven card heights/baselines.
Unauthenticated GET /api/auth/me fires twice on first paint, producing two red 401 console errors on the public login page. Cosmetic but noisy; should be gated on token presence or handled silently.

action_items: Add login brute-force lockout / rate limiting (5 failed attempts -> 423/429) as required by the auth playbook.
Tighten CORS: remove allow_origin_regex='https?://.*' when allow_credentials=True; use explicit FRONTEND_URL origin list.
Replace native date/datetime inputs with the shadcn Calendar component in Tasks.jsx, Money.jsx, Calendar.jsx, More.jsx.
Pre-fill the Calendar add-appointment datetime with the currently selected day.
Use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) in PATCH handlers so fields can be cleared.
Split /app/backend/server.py (842 lines) into routers (auth, tasks, money, docs, ai, dashboard) — exceeds the 700-line guideline.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:838 — allow_origin_regex=r'https?://.*' with allow_credentials=True defeats the explicit origin allow-list and is a real security hole given the SameSite=None auth cookie.
server.py:271/309 — 'if v is not None' filtering in PATCH prevents nulling fields; use exclude_unset.
server.py — no rate limiting on /auth/login or /auth/register; register is also unthrottled and could be used to spam users.
server.py is 842 lines; extract APIRouters per domain.
Naming inconsistency: More.jsx tab testid is 'more-tab-docs' but the panel testid is 'documents-list' — align to 'documents'.

Positive: all list/CRUD handlers correctly scope by user_id and strip MongoDB _id; UUID string ids used consistently; bcrypt hash verified as $2b$12$ (60 chars); httpOnly cookie confirmed on login response.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (34 tests, run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v). NOTE: the email-validator rejects '.test' TLDs — use @qamail.com for synthetic users. Register lowercases emails, so assert against email.lower(). Only failing test is TestHealthAndAuth::test_brute_force_lockout (feature genuinely absent). Frontend testids confirmed: nav-{home,tasks,calendar,money,assistant,more} on desktop and nav-*-mobile on <=768px; More tabs are more-tab-{docs,habits,shopping}; task filters task-filter-{all,todo,in_progress,done}; dynamic rows task-item-<id>/bill-item-<id>/expense-item-<id> with toggle-task-<id>, pay-bill-<id>, delete-*-<id>. AI chat streams in ~10-15s, plan-my-day in ~20-40s.
rca_of_the_issue: Two initial pytest failures were test-side, not product defects: (1) email-validator rejects the reserved '.test' TLD -> 422 on register; fixed by switching synthetic emails to @qamail.com. (2) register/login lowercase the email server-side, so asserting equality with a mixed-case 'TEST_' prefix failed; fixed by lowercasing test emails. The remaining failure (brute-force lockout) is a genuine missing feature: /api/auth/login in server.py has no attempt counter or rate limiter, so unlimited credential-stuffing attempts return 401 indefinitely. Calendar 'appointment not visible' was reproduced and root-caused to the form not defaulting to the selected day — the POST succeeded (verified via API) but the record landed in a different month than the grid being viewed.
